description: This file defines the main entry point for a React frontend application for a food delivery service. It sets up routing, contextual providers, and access control for different pages such as login, registration, restaurant listings, cart, checkout, and order tracking.

classes.name: RequireAuth
classes.description: A React component that enforces authentication before rendering its children by redirecting unauthenticated users to the login page.

methods.name: RequireAuth({ children })
methods.description: React component for protecting routes that require authentication. Uses the `useAuth` hook to check authentication status and `useLocation` to preserve the intended destination on redirect.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main application component setting up providers and routing for the frontend app.
